+DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 30
+
+def format_duration(seconds):
+    """Convert seconds to human-readable duration string."""
+    minutes = seconds // 60
+    secs = seconds % 60
+    return f"{minutes}m {secs}s"
+
